title: Current and Rivergate
author: Sable Ravensworth
blurb: Freya Joubert, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
